children: The Small Industries Development Bank of India (SIDBI) had accepted bids worth 56.0740 billion rupees ($592.06 million), for the sale of bonds maturing in five years, three bankers said on Wednesday.
The state-run financial institution will pay a coupon of 8.17%, and had invited commitment bids for the issue earlier in the day, they said.
SIDBI did not respond to a Reuters email seeking comment.
